# INV-USD-001, a USD invoice, linked to money that arrived in the CAD bank,
# stating the transaction alone.
#
# The same payment as `a_payment_linking_a_cad_bank_to_a_usd_invoice.txt`,
# without `txn_split_guid:`. The block then leaves the run to find the split
# that settles the invoice, and that path works out what the settlement is
# worth before it asks whether it can: the parked split is CAD and so is the
# bank, so nothing in the transaction is USD and there is no figure to read.
#
# What this fixture produces: the refusal the other spelling meets, stating
# both currencies and what to write instead.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-01
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank"
    txn_guid: "d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90011223"
